Ann has presented John Rayner with their first son Jack, while Liz and Leo Lyons are counting their blessings because their second daughter, who was due in December, arrived 12weeks premature in September.

Honary Coaching member Mike Dunphy and wife Ann are moving house from Welwyn Garden City to High Wycombe. Mike who has coached many of our fine middle distance men will be cutting back on some of his coaching commitments.
